reserveReview.rationale: UHY's independent auditors' reasonable-assurance report, dated October 15, 2026 and digitally signed October 16 at 13:50:19 BRT, applies NBC TO 3000/ISAE 3000 to the assertion that BRL reserve assets were at least BRLA in circulation as of September 30, 2026 at 11:59:59 PM UTC. Its unmodified opinion states that the assertion is adequately presented in all material respects. The report records BRL 72,064,692.29 cash and equivalents and BRL 60,103,684.97 overnight repos, totaling BRL 132,168,377.26 against BRL 129,478,160.68 circulation across Polygon, Moonbeam, Celo and Gnosis. Cash is itemized across Stark Bank, Woovi, BTG Pactual, Itaú Unibanco and XP Investimentos; repo claims are BRL 30,103,684.97 with BTG Pactual and BRL 30,000,000.00 with XP. The repos are collateralized by Brazilian corporate debentures with next-business-day liquidity, not sovereign securities. The normalized composition is 54.524913% cash and 45.475087% repos. The five-page official PDF is 887263 bytes with SHA-256 fae95580de235d577bbfd92b384d33b9bde0c8105b16180aeb18edf6ed6602f4. Individual debenture issuers and reserve-account legal safeguards remain undisclosed.
